name: greprules
description: Use greprules to fetch greprules.io rule packs, run OpenGrep scans, and read agent-friendly results.

install_opengrep.title: Install OpenGrep automatically
install_opengrep.description: Recommended. When enabled, greprules downloads and manages OpenGrep automatically. Turn this off to use an existing opengrep on PATH.

opengrep_path.title: OpenGrep executable path
opengrep_path.description: Optional. Set this only when you want greprules to use a specific OpenGrep executable instead of automatic install or PATH lookup.
